# London Dental Specialists

> A Central London dental practice offering specialist services across multiple disciplines, led by Dr. Ope Sodeinde with comprehensive aftercare guidance for all procedures.

London Dental Specialists is a specialist dental practice in Central London (NW1 8UR) providing expert care across endodontics, oral surgery, periodontics, cosmetic dentistry, and dental implants. The practice is GDC-regulated and offers professional training programs alongside patient care.

## Key Topics

- Dr. Ope Sodeinde
- Dental Implants
- Periodontics & Gum Disease
- Oral Surgery
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Root Canal Treatment
- Aftercare & Recovery
- Central London
- GDC Regulations
- Sedation Dentistry
- Emergency Dental Care
- Paediatric Dentistry
- Post-Treatment Care
- Halitosis Treatment
- Professional Training

- [Aftercare Guide for Cosmetic Dentistry in London, England | London Dental Specialists](https://london-dental-specialists.co.uk/cosmetic-dentistry/cosmetic-dentistry-aftercare-guide): Cosmetic dentistry recovery and smile maintenance aftercare
